rationale: C09 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Both are letters to governors calling a Washington highway-safety conference, invoking the existing Action Program, describing the conference as a means to stimulate public participation, and requesting state delegations and gubernatorial leadership. C05 also contributes closely related language and machinery, while C19 is a weaker general conference-delegation analogue.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Accordingly, I have called a Conference on Highway Safety for Washington next February seventeenth, eighteenth and nineteenth.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am calling a national meeting of the Highway Safety Conference... The meeting will convene in Washington June 1 to 3.
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive parallel announcement of a Washington highway-safety conference with specified dates.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Conference will serve to focus more public attention on the problem and stimulate active leadership in every community.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: to stimulate application of the Action Program in the States, particularly through the adaptation of the Program to the needs of communities and rural areas.
shared_material.explanation: Both state the conference's operative purpose as stimulating community- and state-level implementation of the same Action Program.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I should appreciate your designating an appropriate group of your outstanding citizens as a delegation to represent your state.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I urge you as the Chief Executive of________to attend the Conference as head of your_______delegation and to lend it your personal leadership.
shared_material.explanation: Parallel request that each governor organize or lead a state delegation and provide active leadership.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the "Action Program for Highway Safety" which you and the other Governors have developed
shared_material.parent_excerpt: application of the Action Program in the States
shared_material.explanation: Both center the conference on implementation of the specifically named highway-safety Action Program.
